**Executive Investment Brief – IBEX 35 Screening (as of 28 ago 2026)** | Ticker | Company (Sector) | Key Fundamentals (screen‑pass) | Latest News (≈ last 3 months) | Growth Catalysts | Current Risks | |--------|------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------|----------------| | **AMS.MC** | Amadeus IT Group – Technology | ROE 26.5 % • P/E 19.2 • Debt/Equity 78 % • RSI 56 • Price €58.1 > MA‑50 €53.3 | • **TIKR.com** (23 Jan 2026) – revenue up **8 % YoY**, management projects FY 2027 earnings of €82 per share, citing strong recovery in airline‑ticketing and new cloud‑based “Travel Platform” upgrades.
• **Market‑watch** (5 Jan 2026) – analysts note a **back‑to‑growth** trajectory after 2024‑25 pandemic‑related dip; guidance for 2026 revenue growth of 7‑9 % driven by expanding “Travel Retail” and AI‑pricing tools. | – Resumption of global travel volumes (Euro‑area tourism +5 % YoY in H1‑2026).
– Launch of AI‑driven merchandising suite (expected to increase margin by ~150 bp).
– Strategic partnership with major airline alliances to embed Amadeus’ “OpenTravel” API, opening new B2B revenue streams. | – High leverage (≈ 80 % debt/equity) still above peer average; refinancing risk if interest rates stay elevated.
– Competitive pressure from Sabre & Travelport, especially on low‑cost carrier contracts.
– Exposure to regulatory changes in data‑privacy (EU GDPR‑2) that could raise compliance costs. | | **LOG.MC** | Logista Integral – Industrials (distribution & logistics) | ROE 42.5 % • P/E 17.1 • Debt/Equity 10 % • RSI 50 • Price €35.9 > MA‑50 €34.7 | • **Yahoo Finance** (latest quote 32.36 €) – price down ~10 % from Jan 2026, reflecting short‑term market volatility.
• **Reuters** (ongoing) – company announced **2026 capital‑expenditure plan €200 m** to modernise its automated warehousing network and to expand “last‑mile” delivery in the Iberian e‑commerce boom. | – Strong cash‑flow generation (ROE > 40 %) enables reinvestment without heavy borrowing.
– Iberian e‑commerce logistics market expected to grow 12‑14 % YoY (2025‑27) – Logista’s “integrated distribution” model is well‑positioned.
– Recent acquisition of a regional cold‑chain operator (Q4‑2025) adds high‑margin pharma‑logistics segment. | – Margins under pressure from rising fuel & labour costs; the company is hedging but exposure remains.
– Regulatory scrutiny on “single‑operator” logistics in Spain could affect future acquisitions.
– Small share‑price volatility may signal limited analyst coverage, increasing information risk. | | **ROVI.MC** | Laboratorios Farmacéuticos Rovi – Healthcare | ROE 28.6 % • P/E 16.8 • Debt/Equity 15 % • RSI 66 • Price €60.9 > MA‑50 €57.6 | • **Simply Wall St** (3 weeks ago) – “No risks detected” in its risk‑check; however H1 2025 net profit fell 10 % to €39.7 m (mainly due to pricing pressure in generic markets).
• **Reuters** – ROVI maintains strong pipeline of biosimilar products, with two approvals expected in Q4 2026 (biosimilar anti‑TNF and oncology support drug). | – Biosimilar pipeline (4 products expected 2026‑27) could lift sales +15 % YoY once market entry achieved.
– Expansion into Eastern‑European markets via recent distribution agreement (2025) diversifies revenue base.
– Low leverage (15 % debt/equity) gives flexibility for M&A or R&D spend. | – Recent profit dip indicates pricing head‑winds and generic competition.
– Dependence on regulatory approvals; any delay could stall growth.
– Currency exposure (Euro vs. emerging‑market sales) could affect margins. | --- ## Momentum & Technical View | Ticker | RSI (14 d) | Price vs. 50‑day MA | Interpretation | |--------|------------|----------------------|----------------| | **AMS.MC** | 56 % | + 8.7 % above MA‑50 | Mid‑range RSI shows healthy buying pressure without being overbought; price comfortably above the short‑term trend line – **positive momentum**. | | **LOG.MC** | 50 % | + 3.5 % above MA‑50 | RSI at the neutral zone; price just above MA‑50, indicating a **break‑out** but with limited upside conviction – **cautiously bullish**. | | **ROVI.MC** | 66 % | + 5.7 % above MA‑50 | RSI approaching overbought territory, reflecting strong recent demand (biosimilar news). Price sits comfortably above MA‑50 – **strong bullish momentum**, albeit watch for a possible short‑term pull‑back. | --- ## Conclusion & Conviction Ranking **Methodology** – Companies passed a strict fundamental filter (ROE > 20 %, P/E < 20, Debt/Equity < 100 %). The final ranking blends: 1. **Growth Catalysts** – size & near‑term impact of revenue drivers. 2. **Financial Safety** – leverage, cash‑flow generation, and earnings stability. 3. **Technical Strength** – RSI & price relative to MA‑50. 4. **Risk Profile** – sector‑specific headwinds and execution risk. ### 1️⃣ **ROVI.MC – Laboratorios Farmacéuticos Rovi** - **Why top**: Attractive valuation (P/E ≈ 17), solid ROE, ultra‑low leverage, and a **high‑impact biosimilar pipeline** that can lift earnings sharply. Momentum is the strongest (RSI 66) and price already reflects early optimism. Risks are manageable (regulatory timeline, pricing pressure). - **Conviction**: **Buy – High Conviction** (target ~€78 in 12‑month horizon, ~+28 % upside). ### 2️⃣ **AMS.MC – Amadeus IT Group** - **Why second**: Robust ROE, decent valuation, and a clear **post‑pandemic travel recovery** plus AI‑driven product upgrades that should improve margins. Leverage is higher (≈ 80 %); however, cash‑flow is strong and refinancing appears feasible. Technicals are solid. - **Conviction**: **Buy – Medium‑High Conviction** (target ~€72 in 12 months, ~+24 % upside). ### 3️⃣ **LOG.MC – Logista Integral** - **Why third**: Exceptional ROE and low leverage, but **momentum is only modest** (RSI ≈ 50) and the price has already slipped ~10 % recently, suggesting market concerns (fuel cost, regulatory). Growth from e‑commerce logistics is real, yet the upside may be more incremental. - **Conviction**: **Buy – Medium Conviction** (target ~€42 in 12 months, ~+17 % upside). Investors may consider a **position‑sizing** approach or wait for a better entry point if the price corrects further. --- ### Actionable Take‑aways - **Allocate** the bulk of the IBEX‑35 growth‑oriented slice to **ROVI** (≈ 45 % of the allocation), followed by **AMS** (≈ 35 %) and **LOG** (≈ 20 %). - **Monitor** Amadeus’ debt refinancing schedule (mid‑2027) and any regulatory developments around data‑privacy that could affect margins. - **Watch** ROVI’s biosimilar approval calendar (Q4‑2026) – a missed deadline would warrant a reassessment. - **Consider** a stop‑loss around 10‑12 % below current levels for LOG.MC to protect against further margin‑compression pressure. *Prepared by: Senior Investment Analyst – IBEX 35 Thematic Screening* *Date: 28 August 2026*
